intersections.note: north leg of Mitchell Avenue (from the north-north-west)

notes: Spring Grove Avenue: the wide diagonal street with car tracks; its name is not printed inside this strip (presumed). Mitchell Avenue arrives from the north-north-west (label MITCHELL far up, AVENUE near x2750 y3300) and leaves south-east from nearly the same point as Donnell Avenue (printed AVE. north, DONNELL south); the three legs meet Spring Grove Avenue within about 55 px. Hope Street is printed HOPE ... ST. between blocks 23 and 24. Most of the strip is factories, rail sidings, tracts and the Mill Creek: no other street crossings found.
